incompatible_feature_width_is_rejected.expected: feature width 4 is rejected for declared 1x1o input dim 3
incompatible_feature_width_is_rejected.exclusion_note: The layer must not silently accept tensors whose last dimension disagrees with the declared input irrep width.

scalar_only_irrep_does_not_admit_vector_.exclusion_note: A scalar-only declaration is dimensionally distinct from a vector irrep declaration in this tiny fixture.

zero_batch_preserves_declared_output_wid.boundary_note: Zero rows are allowed as an empty batch while the declared feature width remains enforced.

scalar_only_tensor_product_preserves_sca.boundary_note: Scalar-only irreps remain in the same declared scalar feature width for this bounded product layer fixture.

surviving_alternatives: Other e3nn O(3) operations may remain useful; this micro receipt only covers Irreps parsing and bounded tensor product layer dimension behavior.
demotion_condition: Demote e3nn for this function surface if o3.Irreps reports incorrect dimensions for the bounded fixtures, if FullyConnectedTensorProduct or TensorProduct returns a last dimension different from the declared output irrep dimension, or if incompatible feature widths are silently accepted.
out_of_scope: no proof of the whole e3nn library
no training, optimization, or learned-weight claim
criteria_checked: e3nn o3.Irreps parses tiny scalar/vector declarations
TensorProduct with explicit instructions preserves declared output dimension
zero-batch and scalar-only boundary fixtures preserve declared dimensions
